sheets.prompt:
Create a production-ready TRANSPARENT PNG GAME LETTERING ATLAS. This is a sprite asset sheet, not a UI screenshot, poster, page, or font specimen. Reference images show the exact APPROVED Chinese snowball game art style. The user rejects formal typefaces and requires EVERY UI word to be custom drawn in the same character as the reference: rounded and friendly thick felt-tip strokes, naturally varied outlines, lively small baseline irregularities, simple readable Chinese, like the captions/buttons in the reference. No squared generic Heiti, no Songti, no thin strokes, no standard typography, no sports italics, no texture or 3D.
Pure transparent background across the canvas, including all gutters. Only the requested lettering is visible. No white paper, black background, grid lines, cell borders, buttons, labels, row numbers, headings or ornaments. ALL ink is contained in the cell interiors with at least 15% clear transparent padding at every cell edge; never cross a grid boundary. Equal cell widths/heights. Center each requested item in its assigned cell. Include every Chinese character and punctuation exactly once as specified. Do not abbreviate, repeat, skip, or change the text. Match the reference's rounded stroke and organic shape, not a font substitute. Use the same visual size for glyph heights across comparable items, adapting size only for longer phrases to fit safely.
Layout: 2 columns and 4 equal rows, 2048x2048 or higher. White filled chunky ORIGINAL hand-lettered Chinese, with only a slim muted mountain-blue outline (#5B82A6), matching the reference's large bubbly page headings. Opaque white inside the lettering, transparent outside and in counters. Not a drop shadow. Each item on ONE line. Exact cell contents, row by row left to right:
Row 1: "雪山生存指南" | "选择你的对手"
Row 2: "你赢了！" | "平局"
Row 3: "练习结束" | "雪球"
Row 4: "获胜" | "决战雪山之巅".
